nodes.label: Immutable provided CSVs and archive schemas
Audited hourly grid and evaluation labels
Availability, leakage, DST and reproducibility tests
Contract and source identity lock
nodes.rationale: Contract and source hashes fail on mismatch instead of silently changing the experiment.

nodes.label: Forecast-origin available-information replay
nodes.rationale: Forecast runs and observation versions must have been available before the relevant origin or model fit.

nodes.label: Demand, RTE and weather vintage archives
Authentic-archive and interval-lineage gate
nodes.rationale: Empty archive schemas and unverified provided D1 values cannot establish historical operational availability.

nodes.label: Interval end plus two-hour availability assumption
nodes.rationale: Original observation publication and revision vintages are absent, so retrospective runs disclose an availability approximation.

nodes.label: Retain missing targets and genuine peaks
nodes.rationale: Evaluation targets are not interpolated; incomplete days are excluded only when complete trajectories are required.

nodes.label: Chronological validation and declared online updates
nodes.rationale: Validation selects features and policies; scheduled refitting and calibration may use earlier evaluation observations only after availability.

nodes.label: Four baseline policies and matched scorecards
Ineligible realized-future-weather sensitivity
nodes.rationale: Realized future weather diagnoses sensitivity but cannot win operational model selection.

nodes.label: Complete residual-day trajectory scenarios
nodes.rationale: Separate hourly intervals do not establish simultaneous daily energy or peak uncertainty.

nodes.label: Retrospective evidence boundary
nodes.rationale: Forecast issues, weather runs and original observation vintages are unverified; current comparisons establish no operational superiority.

nodes.label: Previously explored chronological test
nodes.rationale: Earlier full-history EDA exposed the test period; freezing code cannot restore a pristine holdout.

nodes.label: Unverified source-to-hourly conversion
nodes.rationale: Matching timestamps do not prove matching intervals; hourly mean power and interval-start labels are assumptions.

nodes.label: Prospective shadow validation recommendation
nodes.rationale: Unverified vintages, source conversion, exposed test history and stale inputs prevent a procurement deployment claim.

nodes.label: Achieved quantile and past-error coverage
nodes.rationale: Nominal 90% quantile intervals under-cover; further development must use validation or new prospective evidence.

nodes.label: Separate procurement and financial evaluation
nodes.rationale: Euro savings require prices, applicable settlement rules and a shared procurement policy; national demand is not a validated customer portfolio.

nodes.label: Freshness, snapshot, forecast, fallback, archive and monitor pipeline
Append-only compressed per-origin forecast ledger
nodes.rationale: Each origin is closed before the next origin can fit on newly available outcomes.

nodes.label: Behavioral falsification and evidence checks
nodes.rationale: Mutating unavailable future observations must not change origin features, forecasts or calibrated intervals.
